description: Which export destinations this account has connected (Close, GoHighLevel, Google Sheets) and whether each is ready to receive leads. Check this BEFORE export_leads or create_automation with a CRM destination — those fail if the integration isn't connected. Close with no saved field mapping sends Close's own fields (name, website, address, contact, phone, email). File destinations (csv/xlsx/json) always work and need nothing connected.
